# Connect UnifAPI to your client

One OAuth sign-in connects the UnifAPI public-data MCP server to your assistant — read-only, no API key to paste. Pick your client for step-by-step setup, or open the full picker at https://unifapi.com/mcp.

## Web connector — smoothest

- [Claude](claude/) — Web connector — the smoothest path
- [ChatGPT](chatgpt/) — Web connector — no terminal
- [Perplexity](perplexity/) — Web connector — no terminal
- [Grok](grok/) — Web connector — no terminal
